claims.text: The change in both endpoints of the target range between the June 10, 2020 statement and the July 2020 statement was zero (lower endpoint unchanged at 0 percent; upper endpoint unchanged at 1/4 percent).

claims.text: The supplied excerpts cannot establish whether any intervening FOMC decisions on the target range occurred between the two statements, because the excerpts are partial and provide no meeting calendar or intermediate records beyond the two quoted decisions.

A caveat on dating: while the fed-2020-june excerpt is explicitly dated June 10, 2020, the fed-2020-july statement's own date does not appear in its quoted excerpt; its July 29, 2020 date is evidenced only by the related implementation notice referencing "its statement on July 29, 2020," not by the statement text itself.
